title: MCPack — Product Requirements Document v1.1
summary: PRD covering multi-source composition, dynamic role resolution (Google OAuth), token-based deterministic inverted-index search, and HTTP/SSE transport — board-deferred from v1.1 to v1.2 milestone.
milestone_override_reason: Board decision 2026-04-25 deferred this PRD to v1.2 (Partner Hub). Sibling PRD mcpack-prd-v1.1-gsd.md takes the v1.1 slot.

locked_decisions.decision: Replace v1.0 5-tier keyword scorer with deterministic weighted inverted index built at startup (TOOL_NAME=10, DESCRIPTION=5, PARAM_NAME=2).
locked_decisions.conflict_with_sibling: Sibling PRD (v1.1) keeps the v1.0 5-tier scorer as the keyword leg of a hybrid (semantic+keyword) ranker. Conflict likely resolves cleanly because changes target different milestones (v1.2 vs v1.1) — but synthesizer must verify ordering: v1.1 hybrid retains 5-tier scorer; v1.2 may replace it with the inverted index.

locked_decisions.decision: Auth resolution happens at the transport layer BEFORE source composition runs. Auth provider is never a source. Resolves circular dependency.
locked_decisions.conflict_with_sibling: none — architectural invariant scoped to multi-source/transport, not present in sibling

locked_decisions.decision: resolveRole(session) is the provider-agnostic extension point. Built-in resolvers ship in separate packages (@llvs/mcpack-google, @llvs/mcpack-workos, @llvs/mcpack-auth0) to keep core zero-dependency.
Tool name collisions are prefixed with source.toolname; non-collisions keep original names.
Graceful shutdown: SIGTERM all stdio children, wait up to 2s per process, then SIGKILL.
@llvs/mcpack-google peer-depends on @llvs/mcpack ^1.1.0 and uses google-auth-library ^9.0.0; core stays zero-dependency.
Static resolver does NOT verify JWT signatures — base64-decodes payload only. Use only when transport is trusted (local stdio, internal network).
Version number 1.1.0 claimed in §12 Definition of Done for both @llvs/mcpack and @llvs/mcpack-google.
locked_decisions.conflict_with_sibling: VERSION COLLISION — sibling PRD also claims v1.1.0. Per board decision (2026-04-25), this PRD is deferred to v1.2; synthesizer must rewrite all 1.1.0 references in this doc to 1.2.0 and reassign the v1.1.0 version to the sibling PRD's deliverables.

requirements: Multi-source mode: createMCPackServer accepts sources[] of named MCP server instances
Spawn each source as stdio child process at startup
Pull tool definitions via tools/list from each source
Prefix tool names with source name only on collision
Build merged inverted index across all sources
Route tools/call to correct source by tool name prefix
Apply role filtering across full merged surface using namespace-aware wildcards
Warn on tool name collision with explicit message
Dynamic role resolution via resolveRole(session) hook on config
Auth resolution at transport layer before source composition
Ship @llvs/mcpack-google with Google JWT verification via JWKS
Ship built-in staticResolver in core (no JWT signature verification)
Token-based inverted index built at startup (zero runtime overhead)
Tokenize: lowercase, strip punctuation, length>1 filter, weighted by field
HTTP/SSE transport on configured port (default 3000, default path /sse)
Extract Authorization Bearer header at transport boundary
Pass headers to resolveRole(session) for role attachment
Graceful shutdown: SIGTERM children, 2s wait, SIGKILL stragglers
All v1.0 wrap mode and build mode behavior unchanged
All v1.0 tests must continue to pass

cross_references.note: Sibling v1.1 PRD covers the v1.1 milestone (semantic search overlay, hybrid ranker keeping v1.0 scorer as keyword leg, plus other v1.1 work). This PRD covers multi-source composition, auth/resolver hook, Google OAuth, HTTP/SSE transport — the complementary set the sibling explicitly defers. Two PRDs are sequential (v1.1 → v1.2), not overlapping in feature surface, but DO collide on (a) version number 1.1.0 and (b) search-engine direction (sibling preserves v1.0 5-tier scorer; this doc replaces it with inverted index).

risks: MCPack depends on MCP SDK's low-level Server class for setRequestHandler — monitor SDK releases for breaking changes
Google JWKS keys rotate periodically — cache with TTL and refresh on verification failure
Source MCP servers spawn at startup; if a source goes down post-startup, calls to that source fail — return isError:true rather than crash gateway
Graceful shutdown takes up to 4 seconds per stdio process — 10+ sources could exceed Railway's shutdown timeout; document max recommended sources
Google JWT lifetime ~1 hour — partners need re-authentication when token expires; mid-session expiry disconnects the partner
MCP protocol gateway patterns are actively being standardized — monitor SDK releases for gateway-related updates that could conflict

synthesis_conflict_flags.description: Both this PRD (§12 DoD, §5.7 package.json snippet) and sibling mcpack-prd-v1.1-gsd.md claim v1.1.0. Per board decision 2026-04-25, this PRD is deferred to v1.2.0; sibling retains v1.1.0. Synthesizer must rewrite version references in this doc.

This PRD §3.4 + §5.4 REPLACES v1.0 5-tier scorer with deterministic inverted index. Sibling PRD KEEPS v1.0 5-tier scorer as keyword leg of hybrid (semantic+keyword) ranker. Likely resolves cleanly because changes are sequenced (v1.1 hybrid keeps scorer; v1.2 may swap to inverted index) — but synthesizer must explicitly order them in REQUIREMENTS/ADRs and reconcile against existing v1.0 src/search.ts.
synthesis_conflict_flags.resolution_hypothesis: v1.1: hybrid ranker = semantic_overlay + v1.0_5tier_scorer. v1.2: optionally replace 5-tier leg with inverted index, OR keep both side-by-side. Decision must be deferred to a v1.2 ADR rather than locked here.
